description: Decode any JWT to inspect its header and payload claims — with an honest note that signatures are not verified.

faqs.a: No. This tool only decodes the base64url payload so you can read it. Verification needs the signing key, which this tool never sees.
faqs.q: Does this verify the JWT signature?

faqs.a: Anyone holding the token can read its payload, so never put passwords, API keys or other secrets inside a JWT.
faqs.q: Is the data inside a JWT encrypted?

faqs.a: Paste the token into the box or press “Load sample” to try the decoder on an example token.
faqs.q: How do I try it without a real token?

howto: Paste a JWT (header.payload.signature) into the box.
The header and payload decode instantly into readable JSON.
Standard claims like exp, iat and iss are translated into plain dates.
Remember: decoding is not verification — the signature is never checked.
title: JWT Decoder
